LV2_UNIT_IDS.description: F1, the LV2 units mapped to the standard units: one word per unit term of LV2_UNITS_TERMS (kind unit), its x-from the term (the term's uri is the unit as an LV2 file writes it, units:<key>), its const the word of omx-contract's PARAM_UNITS it is. A reader finds the word whose x-from names the term and reads the standard unit; it keeps no table of its own. Every unit term of LV2_UNITS_TERMS has one word here.

LV2_OPENMIXER_UNIT_IDS.description: F1 for the OpenMixer unit spellings (Q7): an LV2 file writes urn:openmixer:unit#<name> for a standard unit that units.lv2 has no term for, and the plugin's TTL defines it (units:Unit). One word per spelling, its title the <name> in lower case, its const the word of omx-contract's PARAM_UNITS it is; its description names the URI as written. A reader lower-cases the name after urn:openmixer:unit# and reads the word of that title.

oneOf.title: dbfs
oneOf.description: urn:openmixer:unit#dBFS is the standard unit dBFS

oneOf.title: lufs
oneOf.description: urn:openmixer:unit#LUFS is the standard unit LUFS

oneOf.title: ratio
oneOf.description: urn:openmixer:unit#ratio is the standard unit ratio

oneOf.title: dbu
oneOf.description: urn:openmixer:unit#dBu is the standard unit dBu

oneOf.title: dboct
oneOf.description: urn:openmixer:unit#dBoct is the standard unit dB-oct

LV2_DESIGNATION_MEANINGS.description: F1, the LV2 designations mapped to the standard meanings: one word per designation a reader maps, its title the term's key (of LV2_PARAMETERS_TERMS, or LV2_CORE_TERMS for lv2:enabled), its const the standard meaning (omx-contract's descriptor meaning). A designation with no word here maps to no meaning.

LV2_PORT_PROPERTY_SCALES.description: F1, the LV2 port properties mapped to the standard scales: one word per port property that sets a control's scale, its title the term's key, its const the word of omx-contract's PARAM_SCALES. lv2:toggled is no scale (a toggle is a kind of control, not a scale), the one port property of the three the mapping names that has no word here.

oneOf.title: integer
oneOf.description: lv2:integer is the standard scale stepped

oneOf.title: logarithmic
oneOf.description: pprops:logarithmic is the standard scale log

LV2_RESOURCE_KINDS.description: F1, the LV2 terms mapped to the standard resource kinds: one word per resource kind an LV2 plugin shows through its own terms, its x-from those terms (each named once), its const the word of omx-contract's RESOURCE_KINDS it is (copied from the from of omx-contract's data/resource-profile.json, which no longer names LV2 terms). A reader finds the word whose x-from names the term and reads the standard kind. The resource units LV2 names (units:frame, units:ms, units:s) are words of LV2_UNIT_IDS, whose consts frames, ms and s are also RESOURCE_UNITS words.

oneOf.title: latency
oneOf.description: the LV2 terms LV2_CORE_TERMS#latency are the standard resource kind latency

oneOf.title: worker
oneOf.description: the LV2 terms LV2_WORKER_TERMS#schedule, LV2_WORKER_TERMS#interface are the standard resource kind worker

oneOf.title: blockLength
oneOf.description: the LV2 terms LV2_BUF_SIZE_TERMS#boundedBlockLength, LV2_BUF_SIZE_TERMS#maxBlockLength, LV2_BUF_SIZE_TERMS#minBlockLength, LV2_BUF_SIZE_TERMS#nominalBlockLength, LV2_OPTIONS_TERMS#options are the standard resource kind block-length

oneOf.title: state
oneOf.description: the LV2 terms LV2_STATE_TERMS#interface are the standard resource kind state
